steps.summary: Signed in and created ticket "fwrd2-n2 RD Bench Ticket" (the replayed procedure had already completed the form submission; only its final navigation step misfired). Verified on the tickets list and on the ticket's detail view at #/tickets/t15: title "fwrd2-n2 RD Bench Ticket", ticket ID RD-1015, status Draft, customer Bench Test Customer, raised 2026-08-26, parts list empty ("No parts on this ticket yet."), with "Mark Ready" and "Archive ticket" actions available.

Added part "fwrd2-n2 RD Part A" (cost $100.00, markup 25%) to ticket RD-1015 via the stored procedure, then verified on the live page: the parts table now shows the row "fwrd2-n2 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | qty 1 | No supplier | $125.00" with a parts total of $125.00. The app's computed price is $125.00 (100 × 1.25).

Added second part "fwrd2-n2 RD Part B" (cost $200.00, markup 25%) to ticket RD-1015 via the stored procedure, then verified on the live page: the parts table shows both rows — "fwrd2-n2 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | qty 1 | No supplier | $125.00" and "fwrd2-n2 RD Part B | $200.00 | 25% | qty 1 | No supplier | $250.00" — with the ticket's overall parts total of $375.00 (125 + 250). The computed price for Part B is $250.00 (200 × 1.25).

Edited part "fwrd2-n2 RD Part A" on ticket RD-1015: cost changed from $100.00 to $150.00, markup kept at 25%. Verified on the live page after refresh: Part A now shows cost $150.00, markup 25%, computed price $187.50 (150 × 1.25); Part B unchanged ($200.00 / 25% / $250.00); ticket's overall parts total is now $437.50 (187.50 + 250.00).

Attempted "Mark Ready" on ticket RD-1015; the app refused with the exact alert: "Ticket is not ready Part \"fwrd2-n2 RD Part B\" has no supplier" (the first refusal, before the replayed procedure set Part A's supplier, was "Ticket is not ready Part \"fwrd2-n1 RD Part A\" has no supplier Part \"fwrd2-n1 RD Part B\" has no supplier" — i.e. every part must have a supplier). To satisfy the precondition I edited each part and set Supplier to "ABC Supplies" (Part A via the replayed procedure, Part B manually via its Edit dialog). After retrying "Mark Ready", the status changed to Ready (confirmed on the detail view: Status: Ready, with "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed" buttons now shown). Parts: A $150.00/25%/$187.50, B $200.00/25%/$250.00, total $437.50.

Deleted both parts from ticket RD-1015 ("fwrd2-n2 RD Bench Ticket") — Part B via the replayed procedure, Part A manually, each with its confirm dialog accepted — and waited until the parts table showed "No parts on this ticket yet." (parts count 0). Then clicked "Archive ticket"; the app archived it without refusal (button changed to "Unarchive ticket", detail view shows Status: Ready with an "Archived" label). Verified on the tickets list: RD-1015 is absent from the active list and appears at the top of the list with an "Archived" badge (status Ready, 0 parts) when "Show archived" is checked. Final confirmed state: parts list empty, ticket archived.

(1) Detail view of RD-1015 "fwrd2-n2 RD Bench Ticket": status Ready, "Archived" label shown, 0 parts listed (table shows "No parts on this ticket yet."). (2) Active tickets list (Show archived unchecked, both pages checked): RD-1015 does NOT appear, and no ticket whose title contains "fwrd2-n2" appears in the active list. (3) With "Show archived" checked: RD-1015 appears at the top of the list with an "Archived" badge (status Ready, 0 parts, created 2026-08-26).
